item: Item 2 — prove diagnoseBusiness DB workspace isolation

investigation.prior_coverage: Only diagnosis.integration.test.ts, which vitest EXCLUDES (**/*.integration.test.ts) — the transaction had never run in the required lane.
investigation.g5_flag: Phase 2 G5 FINAL_REPORT speculated diagnoseBusiness 'may carry further workspace-isolation gaps of the same class'.

tenant_backstop.wired_in: src/lib/db.ts ($extends, verified live in test client)
tenant_backstop.invariant: create/createMany of a workspace-owned model must include workspaceId, else throws WORKSPACE ISOLATION VIOLATION
tenant_backstop.non_workspace_owned_note: No direct workspaceId column; tenancy via engagementId -> engagement.workspaceId. Correct.

investigation.client_lookup: db.clientAccount.findFirst({ where: { name, workspaceId: validatedWorkspaceId } }) — workspace-scoped, no cross-tenant read/reuse.
investigation.conclusion: No workspace-isolation defect on the exercised owner path; G5 speculation disproven for that path.

source_fix.reason: No defect reproduced (Global Rule 10). Added the smallest regression test that proves current correct behavior; documented why no source fix was needed.

proof.guard_mechanism: Live fail-closed tenant backstop: dropping workspaceId from any workspace-owned create in diagnoseBusiness makes test 1 fail with WORKSPACE ISOLATION VIOLATION.
assertions: diagnosis persists engagement + client + condition profile + findings + evidence + recommendations + actions (no owner-facing 500)
all recommendations carry caller workspaceId; count matches result
findings/evidence/actions persisted under the caller's engagement; counts match result
second workspace diagnosing SAME business name creates its OWN client (distinct id, its workspaceId) — no cross-tenant reuse
two same-named clients exist, one per workspace (no cross-tenant collapse)
workspace A engagements do not contain workspace B engagement; workspace B recommendations all scoped to B and its engagement

commit_subject: Phase 3: prove diagnoseBusiness DB workspace isolation
